name: Vampire - Bite (Costs 2 Actions) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a legendary

results.text: With a hiss like rustling silk, the undead lord lunges at his prey's throbbing jugular.
The vampire's crimson eyes gleam as he bares razor fangs in anticipation of the kill.
Moonlight glints off elongated incisors as the ancient predator strikes with chilling precision.
A whisper of death on the wind precedes the monstrous bite of the 13th-level nightwalker.
The air thickens with the scent of decay as the vampire prepares his lethal embrace.
